add.intro: Describe the character first, then upload a photo, scan or screenshot, or give a link. Contributions are public and anonymous.
add.title: Add a character
app.name: Rare Character Compendium
app.tagline: A community evidence wiki for characters and glyphs
batch.intro: One source, several characters. Each row becomes its own character page.
batch.title: Add several characters
browse.emptyIvd: No records with this IVD status.
crop.hint: Drag a box around the character.
crop.label: Crop {n}
edit.conflict: This record changed while you were editing. Open the current version in another tab and copy your changes there.
edit.intro: Changes are public and anonymous. Earlier versions stay visible.
error.changed: The record changed before this action could be applied.
error.comparison: Put one character in each box; ten boxes per relationship.
error.encodings: Use a character set and a code of up to 80 characters.
error.imageOversize: The image is larger than 16 MiB.
error.imageUnsupported: The image must be a valid JPEG, PNG or WebP file.
error.ivd: Enter an IVD sequence such as U+4E00 U+E0100, or choose not registered.
error.length: Check the length of this field.
error.placeSeen: Enter where the character was seen (up to 500 characters).
error.rateLimit: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
error.rateUnavailable: Contributions are temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
error.save: Could not save the record. Try again.
error.title: Something went wrong
evidence.keepImage: Leave the image empty to keep the current one.
extensionE.coverage: {wrong} were not proposed again because the cited glyph was wrong.
extensionE.intro: IRG N1841 withdraws {total} G-source characters from CJK Ext E. {unresolved} remain unresolved for later encoding.
extensionE.title: Withdrawn Extension E
extensionE.wrongGlyph: Not proposed again: cited glyph was wrong
field.author: Author
field.dateHint: Year, year-month, full date, or month. For example 1998, 1998-05, 1998-05-12, or 05.
field.encodingHint: Unicode codes use U+2D6DD; other sets use the code their standard prints.
field.equivalentToHint: The existing character this variant normalizes to.
field.extraImagesHint: Add more photos or scans of the same source.
field.idsHint: Separate descriptions with commas. The first one draws the glyph.
field.imagePaste: Or paste an image with Ctrl+V.
field.linkImageFailed: The post's picture could not be added. Choose a file instead.
field.linkImageWorking: Getting the picture from the post
evidence.type.mention.hint: Discusses the character as a topic.
evidence.type.attestation.hint: Uses the character in a text.
evidence.type.description.hint: Describes how the character is written.
evidence.type.reading.hint: Gives a pronunciation, often as ruby.
evidence.type.relation.hint: Relates it to another character, as a variant or the same character.
field.rightsHint: Upload only an image you have the right to share.
field.sourceImageHint: Common location and device metadata is removed; JPEG orientation is kept.
field.strokesHint: Estimated from the IDS; correct it if needed.
field.suggestionHint: Choose a record to fill its script and IDS.
field.tagsHint: Add a short label; categories above are tags too.
field.title: Title
field.urlHint: A scan, a post, or a catalogue page.
form.relatedIntro: Type variant and erroneous characters into the boxes.
gallery.hint: Remove pictures you no longer need. The first remaining picture is used as the thumbnail.
gallery.title: Pictures
moderate.intro: Signed in as {email}. Hidden entries stay out of the collection.
moderate.title: Hidden entries
new.attribution: A browser cookie links your contributions for 365 days. The stored attribution remains after the cookie expires or is deleted.
relation.intro: Each relation cites one of this character’s evidence records.
relation.title: Evidence-backed relations
report.hint: Reports are anonymous. Notes are visible to moderators.
report.received: Report received. A moderator will review this record.
reports.intro: Signed in as {email}. Reports are anonymous. Dismiss a report to leave the record visible; hiding the record resolves all of its open reports.
reports.title: Open reports
source.title: Source
field.formationHint: Tag the parts of the first description. The formation follows from the tags.
